Prices

Questions

How much do projects in IoT and hardware cost?
An MVP in this group costs $5,000–25,000 (UZS 60–305 mln), a full version up to $100,000. The exact price depends on the solution, the integrations and the scope.
How long does it take?
An MVP takes 4–14 weeks, a full version 10–40 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
Site access and space for the devices; Internet or SIM cards; A budget for the hardware, which is not in the price.
